target_cwe.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
target_cwe.description: The product does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes user-controllable input before it is placed in output that is used as a web page that is served to other users.
remediation_steps: Use parameterized queries and prepared statements
Implement strict input validation with whitelisting
